title: The edit-intent compose lane accepted six goals on 2026-08-22 and landed zero code. Reasons, each specific and checkable
description: The edit-intent compose lane accepted six goals on 2026-08-22 and landed zero code. Reasons, each specific and checkable: two refused for CAPACITY (BUSY) with no draft produced; two failed goal-target inference (no template produces [fs_edit], no template produces [fileEditResult]) despite the lead sentence naming a real repos/<vessel>/src file; one drafted and was correctly rolled back by its own typecheck gate after rewriting an unrelated import to a package that does not exist; one returned verdict=(none) with op_count=?: draining, escalated to patch_with_tools, and still graded false. Two of the capacity refusals were operator-caused by dispatching three goals concurrently into a lane that cannot serve them, which is itself worth surfacing: nothing told the operator the lane was saturated until the refusal. Also observed: reach-patch MATCHED NO ROW (walk-complete), verdict NOT persisted, so these failures are not teaching the selector either. === CORROBORATED 2026-08-23 with five fresh operator dispatches, zero landings, and FIVE DISTINCT failure modes, two of them NEW to this gap. (1,2) feature_compose:busy — capacity, again operator-caused by concurrent dispatch, and each one applied dBeta:2 to an unrelated arm activity:audit-then-debug-tests via the unconditional penalty of gap-mt0kcoyt. (3) feature_compose:rejected — typecheck_dangling_reference; this one is the lane working correctly, the draft was refused before landing and the full compiler error was preserved for the drafter. (4) NEW — interrupted. A mitosis cutover of goal-host-vessel itself scheduled a restart at 02:53, it fired at 02:55, the 240000ms drain deadline expired at 02:59 with the dispatch still in flight, and SIGTERM killed it. The compose had already produced anchors and an edit plan for the correct file. Self-development restarts kill in-flight operator goals because compose outlives the drain window. (5) NEW and structural — goal-seek:no-trace, evicted with: no template produces the inferred target shapes [code_modification_proposal]. This is the same class as the fs_edit and fileEditResult misses above and it links to a separate known finding: code_modification_proposal has a writer, a reader, a registry shape and an activity arm, and zero rows. The shape is advertised but nothing PRODUCES it, so every goal whose target is inferred to it is structurally unreachable. Three distinct unproducible target shapes now recorded for this one lane. oracleLabelWritten was false on all five.
